data.title: 在原七海 · 收拾后的茶
data.description: 碗盘收好后，七海给自己倒了一杯茶。她坐在桌边等水凉一点，手边的抹布已经叠得方方正正。
data.action: sitting with a cup of tea at a tidy table
data.promptProse: After finishing the housework, Nanami sits calmly at a tidy, polished wooden dining table with a steaming cup of tea. A softly folded, clean cloth rests neatly beside her hand, while the gentle warmth of an overhead pendant lamp casts soft shadows, highlighting the serene, organized kitchen area in the blurred background.
